how_to_use: Supply one `description` per icon. Every other field is fixed across the whole set and must not vary between generations.

icon_request._instructions: Fill in `description` below. This is the only field you change per icon — everything else in this file stays fixed. Name the objects, how they are arranged, and anything optional you want (a logo, a base plate, an isometric view). Do not give the icon a title or subject name. See `examples` at the bottom of this file for the expected phrasing.

output.never: Do not draw a checkerboard, grid, or any pattern as visible pixels. Transparency means an empty alpha channel, not a painted checker.
output.art_area: object fills ~82% of frame, centered on optical mass

camera.view: three-quarter hero angle, slightly above eye level
camera.isometric: only when the description explicitly asks for it
camera.avoid: extreme wide angle, distortion, dutch tilt, top-down

form.proportions: accurate and recognizable — objects read as themselves at a glance
form.edges: softened, consistent bevel radius on every part
form.silhouette: clean and readable with color removed
form.detail_scale: uniform across all parts and all icons

materials.note: Icons sit on #FFFFFF. No part may be pure white or it will dissolve into the page. Thin light parts need a darker edge.

lighting.fill: soft, lower opposite side, lifts the shadow side without flattening
lighting.rim: narrow edge highlight along top contours
lighting.environment: flat lighting, no HDR environment map
avoid: glow halo or bloom in the air around the object

shadow.type: soft detached ellipse below the object
shadow.note: The object floats. The shadow implies a surface without touching one.
shadow.base_plate: none, unless the description asks for one

palette.rule_full_chroma: At most one full-chroma surface per icon. Everything else sits in the muted stops.

gradients.direction: vertical, lighter at top, matching the key light

kit.note: Recurring objects. When a description names one, build this structure. Shared parts keep the same size and proportion in every icon they appear in.

yulu_bike.structure: low step-through frame with a flat footboard; a single rounded saddle; upright handlebar with grips, a small rectangular display pod at the center, and a slim headlight below; exposed coil spring on the front fork; two small deep-tread wheels with plain solid dark rims; a shaped fairing panel wrapping the front column and the body beneath the saddle
yulu_bike.colors: body, wheels and handlebar in charcoal; fairing panel is a color slot set by the description

yuma_battery.structure: upright rectangular slab, taller than wide, softly beveled; a recessed rectangular carry handle cut through the top; plain flat faces
yuma_battery.colors: charcoal shell; an optional lightning-bolt symbol on the front face is a state slot set by the description

yulu_warehouse.structure: simple box with a pitched roof and prominent roof trim; a wide roller shutter across the front, open or closed; a solid skirting band around the base

yuma_charging_station.structure: wedge-shaped cabinet, front face angled back toward the top; a grid of about six battery bays (two rows of three) set into the front; a small display panel above the bays; casters at the base
yuma_charging_station.note: Six bays maximum. More becomes texture rather than shape.

battery_shelf.structure: painted steel frame, three shelves, about four slots per shelf divided by vertical partitions; battery packs standing upright in the slots

yulu_logo.form: leaf-and-arc mark only, never the wordmark
yulu_logo.treatment: extruded with real depth when the description calls for a symbol

yuma_logo.form: Y mark with two dots, mark only, never the wordmark
yuma_logo.treatment: extruded with real depth when the description calls for a symbol

brand_routing.mixed_icons: the mark follows the object it sits on, not the icon overall
brand_routing.appears_only_when: the description explicitly asks for a logo

do_not: more than one full-chroma surface per icon
always: same camera angle and light rig on every icon

examples.description: A yulu bike seen from the front three-quarter, with a yuma battery standing upright on the footboard. The bike's fairing panel is cyan. The battery carries a sage green lightning bolt.

A yulu warehouse with its roller shutter raised, and a battery shelf visible just inside holding four yuma batteries. An extruded yulu logo sits on the wall above the shutter. Roof and skirting in cyan, walls in stone.
